headResidentAndMembers.rule: Only an active RESIDENT_HEAD account can be assigned as a Head Resident.
Each room can have only one active Head Resident, and each Head Resident can represent only one active room.
A Head Resident can add and manage room members only for their own active room.
New room members start as PENDING and become active occupants only after Admin approval.
Room members are resident records and do not receive login accounts.
When the Head Resident leaves, pending and approved room members become LEFT, active and pending vehicles become INACTIVE, and the room becomes EMPTY.

occupancyLimits.rule: Total active occupants equal one active Head Resident plus approved room members.
PENDING, REJECTED, and LEFT room members do not count as active occupants.
Admin approval of a room member is blocked when it would exceed the room maximum occupants.

contracts.rule: Assigning a Head Resident creates an active room assignment and an active rental contract for that room and resident.
The current contract management list contains only contracts whose rental and room assignment statuses are ACTIVE.
Removing the active Head Resident ends the active assignment and contract on the removal date.
Ended contracts are retained as historical records and are not treated as current rentals.

utilityReadings.rule: Admin and Staff can record utility readings only for OCCUPIED rooms with an active Head Resident.
A room can have only one utility reading for each month.
New electricity and water readings must be greater than or equal to their old readings.
A usage-based invoice uses the room utility reading from the month before the invoice month.
The first invoice for a Head Resident does not charge usage-based electricity or water.

invoices.rule: Admin and Staff can generate invoices only for OCCUPIED rooms with an active Head Resident.
A room can have only one invoice for each invoice month.
The first invoice for a Head Resident includes the initial deposit, room rent, and applicable non-usage service fees.
Later invoices include room rent, applicable service fees, and electricity and water according to the configured calculation method.
Invoice total amount must equal the sum of its invoice items and cannot be negative.
Only Admin can delete an invoice. UNPAID, PENDING_CONFIRMATION, OVERDUE, or REJECTED invoices can be deleted only when no approved payment or valid receipt exists.
PAID invoices cannot be deleted, and a Head Resident can view only invoices for their own active room.

serviceFees.rule: Each building can have only one active electricity fee and one active water fee.
Electricity and water fees can be calculated BY_USAGE or BY_PERSON.
Additional service fees use fee type OTHER and can be calculated FIXED per room or BY_PERSON.
Only active service fees are used during invoice generation.
Admin manages service fee configuration. Staff can view service fees but cannot create, update, activate, deactivate, or delete them.

sepayPayments.rule: When SePay is configured, an invoice receives one payment code and a QR code for the exact invoice total.
The SePay webhook must pass authorization and identify a matching invoice payment code.
Only an incoming transfer to the configured account with an amount exactly equal to the invoice total can pay the invoice.
A valid SePay webhook changes the payment and invoice to PAID, creates one valid receipt if needed, and sends a paid notification.
Repeated valid webhooks for an already paid SePay payment do not create duplicate receipts.

ADMIN: Has global system control, including account, building, room, Head Resident assignment, contract, service fee, invoice deletion, receipt, expense, task, notification, and activity log management.
Can approve or reject pending room members and manage operational records across buildings.
STAFF: Can view buildings, rooms, and service fees, record utility readings, generate invoices, confirm payments, create expenses, process assigned maintenance requests, and handle assigned tasks.
Cannot create users, assign Head Residents, change service fee configuration, delete invoices, cancel receipts or expenses, or access global Admin activity logs.
RESIDENT_HEAD: Can access only their own active room and related contract, members, vehicles, utility readings, invoices, payments, maintenance requests, feedback, and authorized notifications.
Can submit room members for Admin approval, register vehicles, submit maintenance requests, upload payment proof, and report invoice issues.
Without an active room assignment, resident features that require room access are unavailable.
